whole_source_content_obligations.content: A person should strive throughout life for soft bowels, near a little looseness. Retain endeavor/advice, throughout-life duration and the small degree; do not turn this into an asserted present condition of one named patient.

The text calls this a great general rule in medicine: when stool is prevented or comes out with difficulty, bad illnesses come. Retain the alternative conditions, the general claim and its asserted importance. This review records historical source content, not established medical efficacy, a diagnosis or a new causal law.

The question asks by what means a person may soften the bowels if they have become somewhat hard. The small degree and question-to-answer function must not disappear when converting the following instructions to a note.

If young, eat in the repeated morning expression בבקר בבקר the source material מלוחים, cooked/scalded as שלוקים and seasoned with olive oil, מורייס and salt, without bread. The ingredients are jointly listed; the no-bread qualification is written. No age cutoff, ingredient mass, mixture ratio or dose is supplied. The material words are retained as source terms, not newly established plant or drug identities.

Alternatively drink cooking water of תרדין or כרוב with olive oil, מורייס and salt. Preserve the outer alternative between eating and drinking separately from the inner alternative between the two named cooking-water sources. Preserve the repeated full seasoning list. The alternative does not itself require two preparations or a mixture of both named sources.

If old, drink honey diluted/mixed with warm water in the morning; wait about four hours; after that eat one's meal. Preserve the age guard, honey, water, warmth, morning, approximate rather than exact four hours, temporal order and possessive meal reference. No dilution ratio is provided.

Do thus for one day or three or four days if this is needed, until the bowels become soft. Preserve each stated alternative duration, need qualification, the backward expression thus and the until-condition. Do not silently manufacture a fixed compulsory four-day course, a two-day option, an age threshold or a continue-after-softening rule. The precise backward scope and interaction of the day alternatives with until are retained as interpretation questions below.

translation_and_scope_limits.observation: The stored Glazer text says Carob where the stored Hebrew has כרוב. This review preserves the Hebrew term and the translation discrepancy; it does not settle historical ingredient identity through another source or silently substitute a chosen plant.

Glazer renders these as salted things and brine. The writing exercise cannot charge them as independently verified botanical or preparation definitions. An open lexicon would either teach a justified meaning or retain the exact source expression as unresolved lexical content.

Glazer writes hot extract for the young drinking option. The Hebrew young expression is מי שלק, cooking water; the explicit מים חמים is in the old branch. Do not transfer a separate serving-temperature requirement to the young branch merely from that English adjective. This does not deny that cooking involves heat.

Glazer says breakfast; the Hebrew says סעודתו, one's meal. Morning intake and the subsequent approximate four-hour delay are already written. Do not introduce a second independent meal-type constraint from the English choice.

The nearest antecedent is the old-person sequence, while a broader reference to the softening advice is a possible reading to investigate. No newly consulted edition or grammatical proof settles it here. A deterministic table that applies the closing loop to both age branches makes an extra interpretation; one that applies it only to the old branch also makes an interpretation.

The text supplies one, three or four days, need and until. It does not provide a formal policy for selecting one of those durations, precisely when need is assessed, or a full algorithm for reconciling every possible course and stop time. A note may retain the same expression and ambiguity; it must not claim to recover a unique execution schedule.

The alternatives distinguish permitted descriptions; they do not by themselves prove disjoint ingredients, two different vessels or equal quantities. The seasoning list's repeated names are semantic types, not evidence of the same physical oil/salt portion in two hypothetical preparations.

one_considered_construction.name: Visible case table with a paid condition column and prose action blocks
one_considered_construction.human_purpose: A reader locates the age/indication branch and follows its action block without repeatedly copying a long condition into every instruction. All actual ingredients, alternatives, quantities, times and assertions remain written.
proposed_hand_action: Keep the opening advice, general claim and motivating question as complete prose above the case table, since none is an ingredient or an executable action.

Write the common indication as an explicit table heading, then separate young and old condition cells from their action cells by a visible ruled gutter. The gutter and block extent would be part of the physical message, not invisible parser knowledge.

Write the two young alternatives as explicitly coordinated complete alternatives. An inner alternative remains inside the drinking description. Shared seasonings are not silently inherited from a prior option.
Write the old sequence with the before/after relation and approximate duration. Retain the closing thus-expression visibly instead of choosing an unproved loop scope.

Within a cell, ordinary lexical words and their boundaries would remain readable in a learned language. Overflow would have to remain visibly inside that cell or use an explicit continuation convention; a bare physical line wrap could not secretly select a new branch.
complete_content_sketch_not_a_22_sign_wr: ADVICE throughout life: endeavor that the bowels be soft, near a little looseness.
GREAT GENERAL RULE IN MEDICINE: when stool is withheld OR exits with difficulty, bad illnesses come.
QUESTION: by what means soften the bowels IF somewhat hardened?
IF young: every morning EAT cooked מלוחים seasoned with olive oil AND מורייס AND salt, WITHOUT bread; OR DRINK cooking water of (תרדין OR כרוב) with olive oil AND מורייס AND salt.
IF old: in the morning DRINK honey diluted with warm water; WAIT ABOUT four hours; AFTER THAT EAT one's meal.
DO THUS one day OR three OR four days IF needed, UNTIL the bowels become soft. The source-level backward and duration scope remains unresolved, not a silent algorithm.

decision.reason: The whole source usefully supplies concrete obligations and translation/scope cautions. The one different physical sketch remains incomplete, with its main scope concept already represented by888. Finishing it by introducing a fresh arbitrary alphabet or reverting to a bracketed atom serializer would not supply the missing independent construction advantage. Stop without a quota card.
decision.retained_positive: A genuine human note for this source must distinguish advice, assertion, question, condition, coordinated ingredients, alternatives, approximate time, temporal order and a qualified stopping expression. These distinctions are source-owned and do not require any native word guess.
decision.claim_ceiling: Not an exhaustion of the RAW reserve or of historical medical writing. Not a refutation of all case tables, semantic notation, Hebrew content or a language. No scientific selection, corpus experiment, source normalization, original-manuscript inference or Voynich translation.
